models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Very light, mostly northerly pattern over the Aeolians, seas near flat - but it is far too early to trust the trip dates.
briefing.synopsis: The current picture from ECMWF IFS 0.25 and AIFS (both 01 Oct 00Z), with ICON-2i 2 km for the short range, is a slack, low-gradient regime: no organised pressure feature driving wind over the islands. Consensus winds at all six island points run roughly 1-7 kt through 03 Oct, swinging diurnally between a southerly overnight land breeze at Portorosa and a N-NE component by day, with total wave and swell at 0.1-0.6 ft. Gusts peak around 13-16 kt (Stromboli 18:00 on 01 Oct, IFS 00Z) - note the IFS gust is an interval maximum, so it reads high against a 5-7 kt mean. If this held into the trip it would mean motoring more than sailing and flat water everywhere.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight and through to departure the base is Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and the only sensible call. The 03 Oct consensus there is SE 3.7 kt, gusting 8.4, with swell 0.1 ft (IFS/AIFS 00Z). Nothing in the payload suggests the fleet would want to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: No change of regime signalled for 02-03 Oct: Portorosa shows 4-5 kt southerly overnight backing to N-NE by midday, waves 0.1 ft. For the first leg, Portorosa to Lipari on 04 Oct, the payload's best window is an 06:00 start with SSE 5.5 kt, gusts 11.7, wave 0.1 ft - but that is a 3-day projection and should be re-briefed the evening before.

passage_notes.note: Earliest look: SSE 5-6 kt at 06:00, wave 0.1 ft, computed go. Wind dies to 2-3 kt late morning - expect engine time.
1-4 kt NW-N all day, wave 0.1 ft. Short hop, effectively a motor at this range.
2-5 kt NW-NNW, wave 0.1 ft, computed go across all windows. Four days out - low weight.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea optional return (06 Oct, 11 nm)
passage_notes.note: NNE-NE 5-6 kt, dead downwind, wave 0.3-0.5 ft.
At the very edge of the data: ENE 4-6 kt, wave 0.7-0.9 ft, gusts to 11.5. Treat as pattern only.

cautions: The trip dates themselves are beyond any useful skill. Forecast stability in the payload shows mean direction shifts of 64 degrees at 72-120 h lead across 15 runs - speeds barely move (0.7 kt mean) but the wind direction is effectively unresolved at that range, which matters for berth exposure and point of sail.
ICON-2i only runs ~60-72 h ahead, so the 2 km detail drops out before the later legs; those windows rest on IFS and AIFS alone.
Models disagree at Lipari for 01 Oct 06:00 with a range of 1.8 to 8.1 kt - a reminder that light-air regimes are poorly constrained even at short lead.

Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli (05 Oct) is rated workable, not sheltered: open from every direction, no anchoring, so shelter depends entirely on the calm holding. That is the first berth to re-check once the trip dates come inside range.
The go verdicts in the payload are conservative threshold checks, not decisions - the skipper decides on the day.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i (all 01 Oct 00Z) agree closely on a light, flat regime through 03 Oct, but the 72-120 h stability record shows direction shifting 64 degrees on average, so the pattern is more trustworthy than any specific figure for the trip dates.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
